items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: the original premise of the show was, I think, his vocals and the band of Frankie Carl, the pianist. ... we wound up on the show

ctx.x: Yes. So, he was a kind of legit singer, and with a jazz band it really was kind of a strange mating. As a matter of fact, the original premise of the show was, I think, his vocals and the band of Frankie Carl, the pianist. And for some reason or other, maybe it was because some record of ours was selling, -- I'll never know the reason, actually, but we wound up on the show and it turned out pretty well. And it wasn't too much later, in the following season, we finally got our complete own show and that was for…
took over the show with the trio.
